tagline: A leading high-end inspection and metrology equipment provider for the semiconductor industry
hero_kpi_rationale: Camtek recorded 16% revenue growth to $496.1M in 2025, driven by the launch of the new Hawk and Eagle G5 systems in 2024-2025, reflecting strong demand from the semiconductor sector and an increase in average selling price.

kpis.name: Annual Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated revenue reflecting sales of inspection and metrology systems, including maintenance services.
kpis.description: Revenue increased to $496.1M in 2025 vs $429.2M in 2024, a 16% growth primarily driven by higher average selling prices of units sold due to the new high-end Hawk and Eagle G5 systems.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by new Hawk and Eagle G5 products

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin, indicating profitability on sales after direct costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin was 50.46% in 2025, up from 48.91% in 2024, reflecting a more favorable product mix with premium Hawk and Eagle G5 systems.
kpis.signal: Gross margin improvement due to premium product mix

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue, excluding financial income and expenses.
kpis.description: Operating margin was 25.84% in 2025 vs 25.18% in 2024, slightly up despite negative impact from the Israeli shekel against the dollar on costs.
kpis.signal: Operating margin stable despite currency pressures

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Camtek invested 9.75% of its revenue in R&D in 2025 vs 8.92% in 2024, reflecting continued commitment to innovation in semiconductor inspection and metrology.
kpis.signal: Sustained R&D investment to maintain technological competitiveness

kpis.name: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Selling, general and administrative expenses as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: SG&A expenses represented 14.87% of revenue in 2025 vs 14.82% in 2024, demonstrating effective control of operating expenses.
kpis.signal: SG&A stable as a percentage of revenue despite growth

kpis.name: Net Margin
kpis.explanation: Net income after all expenses, taxes and financial charges.
kpis.description: Net margin was 10.22% in 2025 vs 27.61% in 2024. The significant decline was due to exceptional charges and income tax, reflecting a highly favorable base of comparison in 2024.
kpis.signal: Net margin impacted by extraordinary charges and taxes

kpis.name: Asia-Pacific Revenue (% of Total)
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue from the Asia-Pacific region, primarily China, Taiwan and South Korea.
kpis.description: In 2025, approximately 91% of Camtek's revenue came from Asia-Pacific (China, Taiwan, South Korea and Southeast Asia), reflecting the shift of electronics manufacturing to this region.
kpis.signal: Major geographic concentration in Asian electronics manufacturing hubs

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €1.26B in the latest year

kpis.name: Annual Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in consolidated revenue reflecting demand for premium inspection systems Hawk and Eagle G5.
kpis.description: Camtek recorded 16% revenue growth to $496.1M in 2025, driven by higher average selling prices due to the new Hawk and Eagle G5 systems launched in February and September 2024, respectively.
kpis.signal: Growth sustained by premium high-end product launches

kpis.name: Gross Margin Expansion
kpis.explanation: Improvement in gross margin due to favorable product mix with premium systems.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved to 50.46% in 2025 vs 48.91% in 2024, reflecting a more favorable product mix with high-end Hawk and Eagle G5 systems, which have higher average selling prices.
kpis.signal: Favorable premium product mix enhancing profitability

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2020-2024) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Slowdown in AI semiconductor capital investment
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked first in Item 1A with detailed discussion (3 paragraphs). Intense language ("materially and adversely affect"). ~50% of revenue depends on AI/HBM products. Trend: new major exposure linked to increasing concentration on AI.

risks.title: Extreme geographic concentration in Asia-Pacific
risks.score_rationale: Major risk: 91% of 2025 revenue in Asia-Pacific, 49% in China alone. Detailed discussion enumerating specific risks (political instability, natural disasters, regulation). Highly intense language on China-specific risks.

risks.title: US trade restrictions and export controls
risks.score_rationale: Detailed risk over 2 pages with concrete examples (continuous additions to the Entity List in 2025). High-alert language on increasing complexity and reputational risks. Direct impact on sales in China and compliance.

risks.title: Regional instabilities and hostilities in the Middle East
risks.score_rationale: Camtek-specific risk (based in Israel). Detailed discussion of Iran-Israel conflicts (2024-2026), Hamas, Hezbollah, Houthis. Direct impact on operations, facilities, supply chains, and export airports/ports.

risks.title: Intense competition from better-resourced rivals
risks.score_rationale: Structural industry risk described in detail. Global competitors with greater resources and local low-cost competitors. Impact on margins and pricing. Moderate language but persistent risk.

risks.title: Acquisition integration and management risks
risks.score_rationale: Detailed risk over 1 page with 9 specific sub-risks (due diligence, integration, management distraction, unexpected costs). Active acquisition strategy mentioned. Moderate to high-alert language.

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions for components
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in the risk summary and developed in the context of hostilities and increased demand. Camtek pre-orders components based on internal forecasts. Moderate-alert language.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and related regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in the risk factors summary but not detailed in the provided excerpt. Generic language. Relevant for a technology company operating in Israel and selling to sensitive customers.

ai_positioning.summary: Camtek is a provider of critical inspection and metrology solutions for the semiconductor industry. The company benefits indirectly from growing demand for semiconductor production capacity in Asia-Pacific, but does not directly derive revenue from AI applications and is not positioned as an AI integrator.
evidence: Camtek sells inspection and metrology systems to semiconductor manufacturers
91% of revenue comes from Asia-Pacific where modern fabs are concentrated
The new Hawk and Eagle G5 products are general-purpose inspection solutions for semiconductor equipment makers
No explicit mention of AI or HPC applications in 10-K/20-F filings
